scope: Attachment isolation — T-509, with the upload-lifecycle and read halves of T-501/T-502/T-505
result_scope: V-06-a … V-06-f. V-06-e (a room poster referencing an intro attachment) is the room upload path and belongs to WP-07; the profile-side half — an INTRO_POST asset cannot be attached to a profile post, and a ROOM_POSTER asset cannot be finalized through the profile-post path — is proved here.

cases.claim: A visitor's profile gallery does not contain the intro attachment.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_post_read.rs::a_post_projects_its_attachments_in_position_order — a post projects only its own READY PROFILE_POST media; the read module never references intro_posts, intro_id, audience or room (the_read_module_never_references_an_intro_post).

frontend/src/features/profile-media/__tests__/ProfileMediaGallery.test.tsx::refuses_an_INTRO_POST_media_item_even_if_a_payload_carried_one — a malformed payload naming an INTRO_POST asset renders no image; admitGalleryMedia refuses every non-PROFILE_POST purpose (admits_only_a_READY_PROFILE_POST_asset).

cases.claim: The author's own profile gallery does not contain it either (it was never published there).
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::a_post_with_an_intro_post_media_id_is_rejected — the author owns a READY INTRO_POST asset, and create_profile_post refuses it with AttachmentNotPublishable (400); no post row and no association row is created.
The database refuses the same association independently of the command: the direct insert asserts constraint profile_post_attachments_purpose (migration 0084).

cases.claim: POST /api/me/posts with a media_id owned by another profile → 400/404, no post created.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::a_foreign_media_id_is_rejected_without_revealing_whether_it_exists — the answer for a foreign id is identical to the answer for an absent id (ProfilePostError::Unavailable, 404 RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so the endpoint is not an existence oracle.
backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::a_mixed_body_with_one_foreign_id_creates_no_post — the whole command is one transaction; the valid attachment did not land either.

cases.claim: POST /api/me/posts with a media_id owned by the author but attached to a restricted intro post → rejected unless the media purpose is PROFILE_POST.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::a_post_with_an_intro_post_media_id_is_rejected — the specific attempt to republish a restricted intro attachment.

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_posts.rs::a_room_poster_or_profile_image_media_id_is_also_rejected — the rule is the purpose, not the attachment state: a ROOM_POSTER or PROFILE_IMAGE asset is refused too.
backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::a_room_poster_cannot_be_finalized_through_the_profile_post_path — the upload context refuses the purpose at init, put and finalize.

cases.claim: POST /api/me/room/posters referencing an intro attachment → rejected.
cases.note: The room poster operation is WP-07 (T-604). WP-06 supplies the profile-side prohibition it depends on: UploadPurpose::RoomPoster admits only Purpose::RoomPoster, so an INTRO_POST asset cannot be finalized in the room context either (backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::every_context_refuses_every_other_purpose). The room route itself is not in this branch.

cases.claim: Reading the media by ID as an unauthorized viewer → 404.
evidence: backend/services/concert-service/src/profile_media/authorization.rs::can_view_media — the single decision (E-03 metadata, E-04 bytes), exhaustively tested in that module's unit tests: a visitor sees only public attachments, nothing absent is readable, and a purpose never crosses a surface.

backend/services/concert-service/tests/profile_media_upload.rs::a_foreign_owner_cannot_see_or_continue_an_asset — a non-owner gets ProfileMediaError::Unavailable for metadata and content, the same answer an absent id gets.

backend/services/api-gateway/tests/profile_media_routes.rs::an_unauthorized_media_read_is_a_closed_404_with_no_image_body and ::an_unauthenticated_media_read_is_401_with_no_body — the refusal carries no image bytes.
